I checked every file that imports `isEnabled` and confirmed which ones actually call it. `src/lib/feature-flags.ts` defines the predicate and calls it internally from `snapshotFlags` and `assertEnabled`. I left it out because it's the definition, not a caller.

The files below only import `snapshotFlags`, which builds a precomputed snapshot, so I excluded them:
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/layout.tsx`
- `src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/_lib/tenant-context.ts`
- `src/components/domain/flags/feature-flag-provider.tsx`

`feature-gate.tsx` and `use-feature-flag.ts` don't call it either. They go through `readFlag` in `src/hooks/flag-context.ts`, and that file is the one that calls `isEnabled`.
